WHAT LANDED (coexistence path behind flywheel loop run --engine):
- loop-dispatch schema workflow: one dispatch_job step (assignee=agent, spec.task=planned prompt, spec.profile), on_error fail_run, lint-clean — ADR-0005 "Send becomes a workflow step type" for the loop.
- loop_dispatch_runner: engine ActionRunner shells __send [--profile] [--confirm] — byte-identical to the sync loop (parity invariant).
- engine_loop: WorkflowEngine-backed durable loop — poll_events+poll_swarm leaves (correctness floor unchanged) -> plan_actions -> each dispatch = engine invoke (deterministic run id per invocation/agent/tick, replay-safe) -> durable ctx.sleep. Resume via existing active-loop registry.
- run_engine_loop + --engine flag + LoopParams.resonate_url (serde-defaulted, back-compat).

TESTS +3 (493/493 green): workflow carries the planned action; REAL engine invoke with recording runner (proves Send-as-workflow-step); plan->dispatch byte parity vs legacy __send argv.

DEFERRED (documented in code): mail digests/urgent-wake, escalation tiers, respawn/self-heal, xproj, reply reminders; then 6 e2e-hardened-loop scenarios parity on --engine; then cutover. Next slice starts at engine_loop in durable.rs.
